limitations: This fix/** branch intentionally has only PR-triggered matrix plus fast: five checks, not nine duplicate push+PR checks.

Hosted Codex proves native parser plus SDK invocation of source-entry registered command; installed package MCP is a separate gate. No model-driven Codex invocation or actual ChatGPT tool invocation is established.
All matrix jobs exercised six new installed aggregate scenarios, eight existing metadata and six directory scenarios. No full DCP/WEB acceptance is awarded.
Raw files preserve exact decoded log strings returned by GitHub; Windows CRLF was restored before final hashing after the patch writer normalized intermediate line endings.
mutations: No GitHub, native Windows, source, workflow retry, cancellation or rerun performed by observer.
